current.text: The Spurs started three guards in the preseason and appear set to start Harper, Fox and Castle together. Whether all three get starter minutes is the open question.
The Spurs used him as the primary initiator of the offense.
He is expected to lead the Spurs guard trio in minutes because he is versatile on both ends.
His assists are in doubt if Dylan Harper starts or plays more. A healthy De'Aaron Fox also cuts into his assist chances. Castle, Harper and Fox cannot all take on bigger roles.
San Antonio is deep at guard and its players had low minutes last season. Experts think his minutes may not rise and team minutes may stay low after the long playoff run.
He averaged over eight assists over the final third of last season. He shot 40% from three over the last two months.
In the preseason he is shooting well from the line and the field, but he is taking no threes and his assists are down. He took 14 free throws in his last preseason game.
Experts are not sure whether his good or his bad shooting stretch from last season is the real level. His value depends on whether his three-point shooting holds.
Category experts agree he is overdrafted. They see him as only marginally inside the top 80 and never inside the top 70. Fade him around pick 50 to 66 in category leagues.
In category leagues he should not be drafted ahead of Dylan Harper.
In an auction mock, Josh called a price above 15 USD a bit high.
The Spurs play 3-4-3 games in our fantasy playoff weeks with a March 28 end, which experts call okay but not great. They have only 13 back-to-backs.
The Spurs are expected to be a top team in the West. One expert predicts 63 wins.

durable.text: His assists are elite. Creating and facilitating come more naturally to him, and repeat more reliably, than his shooting.
Turnovers are a major problem. They were eye-popping in playoff games where Fox was out.
He is a poor free throw shooter and has improved only somewhat. His FT% is his weakest shooting category.
Experts call him a weak shooter overall. His projected FG% is close to the pool average.
He is a strong, versatile defender. He can guard positions one through three, sometimes fours, and even small-ball fives.
His steals and blocks are low for a defender of his quality.
He is much less comfortable scoring going left. Defenses that force him left can shut him down.
He is a much better points league player than category league player.

note: For category leagues the experts all say fade him at his Yahoo ADP of about 55. They see his value around 80, and that fits a Yahoo rank of 78, an ESPN rank of 92 and an ESPN value of 3 USD. His Yahoo value is 12 USD and he cost 1 USD in our league last season, so bid in single digits. He fits best in a punt FT% and punt TO build, where his elite assists (7.3 projected) and his rebounds for a guard count fully, and the 74% FT and 3.3 turnovers hurt less. Early in the season, check whether Dylan Harper starts and takes his assists, and whether the better FT shooting from the preseason lasts.
